title: phone-sensor-logger protocol v1: provisioning (QR code contents)
description: The JSON encoded in a setup QR code. It contains a device token, so it is a secret: show it once and never store or photograph it.

endpoint.description: Full HTTPS URL that batches are POSTed to.

profile.description: Optional name of a runtime settings profile the receiver recommends, e.g. 'activity' (see config/profiles in the app repository).
